gui.flow: Actual button events run public install/check/uninstall/reinstall/check; render images reviewed.

shell_integration.scope: Isolated HKCU keys; independent options, literal PATH preservation, ownership, external modifications, receipt failure rollback.

portable_languages.scope: Windows x64; PATH restricted to System32 and external runtime variables removed. Real downloads, unsaved document analysis and owned uninstall. Makefile uses definition navigation; server has no document symbols.

native_plugins.scope: Nine real plugin install/enable/SettingTab/disable lifecycles; CMake download, editable profile draft and cancel, light/dark keyboard focus and bounds, clear and uninstall.

native_shell.scope: Quoted native startup targets, exact resource and one editor identity; isolated private desktop.

corrected_failures: Native initial C++ target was loaded as Markdown before source routing. Startup now adopts through the shared file service after checking unchanged clean native state; read failure/cancellation retains the original leaf.
CMake server requires dynamic file watcher registration. The LSP adapter now uses the shared directory service and releases registrations with the client.
Latest autotools-language-server removed the Makefile executable. The recipe pins a compatible server and tests definitions rather than unsupported symbols.
Initial long private runtime paths prevented native server loading; owned directory names were shortened.
PowerShell 5.1 child output/module loading and exit-code lifetime required a fixed operation script, explicit Utility import and retained process handle.

Early .NET experiments added two owned test entries to the user PATH. Final recipes disable PATH/certificate setup; exactly those two entries were removed and all other entries preserved before delivery.

local_install.uninstall_preflight: Read-only detach plan; no actual user uninstall
local_install.running_windows: Not closed or restarted; save documents and restart all Typora windows to load.

limits: Bundled real community-compatible plugin packages are available in the local extension catalog; not published to an external marketplace.
Managed downloads target Windows x64. Other platforms retain external tool configuration and are not validated here.
Clean-PATH tests are not pristine virtual machines. Complex real projects, all language subtypes and physical input/GPU scenarios were not exhaustively tested.
Analysis runtimes are bundled; complete C/C++ platform headers/SDKs, ShellCheck, build/debug workflows are outside this delivery.
Direct archives are hash pinned; npm/PyPI/NuGet transitive dependency resolution is not a complete reproducible offline lock.
Full UI suite was not run; four related suites and native fixtures passed. Historical black screen, clipping, dual native editor and fenced-code native return issues remain open.

delivery.commit: Recorded in the local requirement ledger after commit
